name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Controlled, domain-neutral step navigation with underline, labelled or segmented progress and optional gentle content transitions.
docs:
## Stepper

Install with `bunx shadcn@latest add @krak-stack/stepper`. Import `Stepper` and optional `StepperContent` from `@/components/ui/stepper` or the package export `@krak-stack/registry/stepper`.

Pass `steps`, `currentStep` and optionally `onStepSelect`. Selection only requests navigation: the host owns routing, saving, validation, completion and available steps. Previous navigation should not submit the form. Completion is explicit, never inferred from position.

Use variant="underline" for compact centered labels and an active underline without circles or numbers. Labelled and segmented progress remain available with horizontal, vertical or responsive orientation. Without a selection callback, progress is read-only. English/French defaults follow KrakstackProvider; locale and message overrides support other languages.

StepperContent accepts the committed step ID, an explicit forward/backward direction, optional animate and optional focusTarget selector. Keep it mounted across step changes. Forward navigation slides the old panel left and the new panel in from the right; backward navigation reverses both. The paired slide takes 500ms with balanced easing inside a stationary clipped viewport, with no fade. The outgoing panel is an inert DOM copy, not a live React form; canvas content is not captured. Put outlines inside StepperContent so both move with their content. Animation is opt-in, skips initial render, respects reduced motion and never blocks navigation. Host code owns drafts and Back/Continue buttons. See /docs/stepper for integration examples and the live preview.
